### `isGreaterThan` (inline helper)

`isGreaterThan value1: string value2: string`

Returns bool: value1 > value2. (Short form `isGreater` does NOT exist.) https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/templating/templating.html

**Kind:** inline helper · **Arity:** 2 argument(s) · **Source:** Hoverfly helper

Example: `{{#if (isGreaterThan a b)}}...{{/if}}`
